Title: Log Analytics gateway in Azure Monitor update—December 2019

Body.Content:
An updated version of the Log Analytics gateway in Azure Monitor is now available. The gateway (previously OMS) is an HTTP forward proxy that supports HTTP tunneling using the HTTP CONNECT command. It sends data to Azure Automation and a Log Analytics workspace in Azure Monitor on behalf of computers that can’t connect directly to the internet.

The new version of the Log Analytics gateway includes reliability updates. Go to the Log Analytics blade in the Azure Portal or the Microsoft Download Center to download and install.
